title: Baylor Stuns No. 5 Oklahoma 45-38 on November 19, 2011
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs Baylor on November 19, 2011?
answer: Baylor beat No. 5 Oklahoma 45-38 in Waco on November 19, 2011. Robert Griffin III threw a 34-yard touchdown pass to Terrance Williams with 8 seconds left, the Bears' first win in the series.
summary: On November 19, 2011, Robert Griffin III threw for 479 yards and a last-second touchdown as Baylor upset No. 5 Oklahoma 45-38 in Waco. Here is the story.
body: On November 19, 2011, a fifth-ranked Oklahoma team traveled to Waco expecting to stay in the Big 12 title race. Instead the Sooners ran into Robert Griffin III on his way to the Heisman Trophy, and they left with a 45-38 loss.

Griffin was spectacular. He passed for 479 yards, a Baylor school record, completed 21 of 34 throws and accounted for four touchdown passes, while also running for 72 yards. Oklahoma scored 38 points of its own, so the game stayed close until the end.

The finish came on the Bears' final drive. Griffin scrambled for 22 yards and hit Kendall Wright for 12 more, then found Terrance Williams racing across the back of the end zone for a 34-yard touchdown with 8 seconds remaining. Oklahoma had no time left to respond.

The result stood out in the series record, too. It was Baylor's first victory over Oklahoma, after years of Sooner dominance in the matchup. Baylor moved to 7-3 overall and 4-3 in the Big 12, while Oklahoma fell to 8-2 and 5-2 in league play.
